enrichment.why: Violet is a squishy (710 HP), immobile mystic caster whose value is a stack of zones: Flow State gives allies slide distance and enemies a scaling slow/DoT, Still Life is a gaze DoT that stuns and permanently banks stats, and Abstract Landscape blocks vision and silences anything that leaves it. The winning item data is unambiguously spirit (Superior Cooldown 76% WR, Escalating Exposure 80%, Boundless Spirit 57%), and the gun path (High-Velocity Rounds 40% pick / 28% WR) is a trap. She fits the tempo meta only through teamfights and objective zones; nothing about her farms or survives a dive.

builds.name: Spirit caster (lead)
builds.notes: Superior Cooldown (~76% WR) and Escalating Exposure (~80% WR) are the standout win items; the kit is cooldown-gated and DoT-based, so both fit.

builds.name: Charge/utility
builds.notes: Extra Charge is the most-picked early item (87%) but sits at ~46% WR — people feel charge-starved, not that charges win.

builds.name: Gun / fire-rate
builds.notes: High-Velocity Rounds at 28% WR says the Living Ink gun line is bait despite the T3 bullet-damage multiplier.

enrichment.matchup_notes: Her exit-silence zone and gaze-stun punish melee who commit (Drifter, Abrams) and casters whose channel/ult she can silence (Seven). She has no dash and 710 HP, so dive assassins (Holliday, Calico, Yamato, Lash) and anything that outranges her (Vindicta, Grey Talon) kill her before a fight starts.
enabled_by: Superior Cooldown / Extra Charge — the kit is cooldown-gated, so cycling Flow State, ult and Still Life is the whole game
Objective-hub teamfights (Sunken Plaza, Bell Tower, Buff Container contests) where a vision-blocking silence zone decides the fight
Her standard 116 heavy melee — she can farm Tough Crates and grouped Haunt camps like a frontline
countered_by: Dive assassins (Holliday, Calico, Yamato, Lash) — no escape, low HP
Long-range poke (Vindicta, Grey Talon) that outranges her zones
Silence Wave / Disarming Hex / Knockdown — interrupt or cancel the Still Life gaze
Healbane / anti-heal — undercuts Still Life's regen talents and Healing Booster
Spirit Resilience / Debuff Reducer — blunts her DoT and exit-silence
enrichment.notes: Confidence low: no ranked data, no creator read, kit judged from tooltips. Still Life's permanent stat bank is the swing factor — if it snowballs in a tempo meta she is A, if games end before it pays she is a B/C. Watch whether the spirit build's high WR holds and whether anyone plays the gun line at all.

card.headline: Spirit zone-caster with a silence ult and permanent-stat gaze; immobile and squishy, snowballs if left alone.
kit_read: Flow State: a travelling brush trail — allies get bonus slide distance, enemies eat a scaling slow + spirit DoT; reactivate for an AoE burst.
Still Life: gaze DoT on a marked hero; completing the sketch stuns and drops a sketch you collect for permanent stats.
Abstract Landscape (ult): vision-blocking ink that buffs allies' Spirit, reveals enemies, and silences + slows them on exit.
Living Ink: stacking fire-rate/gun steroid whose T3 adds bullet damage and cooldown-reduction-per-hit — weaves autos into spell cycles.
card.meta_fit: Her toolkit is a teamfight/objective-zone kit in a tempo map — vision denial and the exit-silence are real value at Sunken Plaza, Bell Tower and Buff Container contests. But she has no mobility and low HP, and the meta rewards dive and early tempo, not a squishy caster who needs fights to go long.
threatens: Drifter — melee bruiser eats the exit-slow/silence when he commits
Abrams — initiator gets kited and silenced leaving the ink
Seven — caster whose channels the silence zone can shut down
threatened_by: Holliday / Yamato / Lash — dive burst she cannot escape
Vindicta / Grey Talon — outrange her and don't enter zones
Silence Wave / Knockdown / Disarming Hex — cancel the Still Life gaze
card.build_read: Build spirit: Boundless Spirit, Superior Cooldown, Escalating Exposure, Spirit Lifesteal, Diviner's Kevlar. The gun line (High-Velocity Rounds, Swift Striker) is underperforming at ~28-33% WR — skip it.
what_to_watch: Does the spirit build's high Superior Cooldown / Escalating Exposure WR survive contact with ranked, or is it small-sample noise?
Does Still Life's permanent stat bank actually snowball games, or does tempo close before sketches pay?
Does anyone make the gun/Living Ink build work, or does she settle as a pure caster?
